insight: Fully open-source and self-hostable, so the prompt-management, eval, and tracing loop can run entirely on your own infra.
name: Agenta
tagline: Open-source LLMOps: prompt management, evaluation, and observability.
description: An open-source platform for building and improving LLM apps. Agenta combines a prompt playground, prompt versioning, evaluation (human and LLM-as-judge), and tracing/observability in one tool. Available as managed cloud or self-hosted, so teams can keep the whole eval-and-trace loop on their own infra.
